en: Vintage postcard-style photograph showing a riverside railway station and small settlement at the foot of a heavily forested mountain. In the foreground is a river with a stone embankment; behind it stands a long wooden station building with a covered platform. Scattered houses and what appears to be a church-like building are visible among trees further up the slope. The scene is framed by a large, forested mountain under a partly cloudy sky. At the top of the postcard is printed text in Romanian.
